# VediCosmic

> Free Vedic tools: today’s tithi and nakshatra, your birth star, planetary hours, numerology and a 17-minute daily sādhana. Calculated in your browser. No ads.

VediCosmic is a free Vedic astrology, panchang, numerology and practice website. Every tool runs its calculations in the visitor's browser.

## Tools

- [Numerology Blueprint](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/numerology): Free numerology calculator: enter your name and birth date to reveal your Life Path, Expression, Soul Urge, Personality, Birthday and Personal Year numbers as animated orbs, a core-number wheel and your highlighted Lo Shu grid — computed instantly and privately in your browser.
- [Mobile Number Analysis](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/mobile-numerology): Free mobile number numerology calculator: find the root number of your phone number, its repeating digit patterns, and how well it harmonises with your Life Path — including two-digit combination analysis.
- [Lo Shu Grid](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/loshu-grid): Free Lo Shu Grid calculator: drop your birth-date digits into the ancient 3×3 magic square and instantly read its ruling planets, repeated-number energies, missing numbers, and arrows of strength and weakness.
- [Chaldean Numerology](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/chaldean): Free Chaldean numerology calculator: type any name, phone number or date of birth to instantly see its Chaldean compound number, reduced root number, ruling planet, and a full per-letter breakdown.
- [Find Your Life Path](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/life-path): Free Life Path number calculator and full numerology console in one: get your DOB chart, name number, lucky colours and numbers, plus a personal prediction for today, this month, and this year.
- [Vedic Birth Chart](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/astrology): Free Vedic birth chart calculator: enter your birth date, time and place to cast a sidereal Rashi chart with your Lagna (Ascendant), Moon and Sun signs, all nine grahas with nakshatra and pada, whole-sign houses and Vimshottari dasha — calculated privately in your browser.
- [Planetary Hours](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/planetary-hours): Free planetary hours (hora) calculator: see exactly which planet rules this very hour wherever you are, and the best activities to align with each planetary hour throughout the day and night.
- [Navagraha Mandala](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/planet-mandala): A free interactive Navagraha mandala: spin a living 360° orbital map of the nine Vedic planets (grahas), watch them circle the Sun, and tap any graha to learn its meaning and mythology.
- [Chakra Balance](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/chakra-assessment): Free chakra test: answer 21 reflective questions to map the balance of your seven chakras on an animated radar chart, revealing which energy centres may need attention.
- [Japa Mantra Counter](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/mantra-timer): Free 108-bead japa mala counter: chant along with eight sacred mantras, track every round with a satisfying tap, and keep a personal daily streak — no physical mala required.
- [Trataka Focus](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/tratak): Free Trataka (candle gazing) meditation guide: fix your gaze on a luminous bindu, candle flame, Om symbol or Sri Yantra in distraction-free full screen, with a timer, breath pacer, and a closing afterimage ritual.
- [Crystal Guide](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/crystals): Free crystal guide: browse twelve crystals by the intentions traditionally associated with them (love, protection, clarity, abundance and more), see how each is used, and build your own crystal kit.
- [Daily Contemplation Card](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/tarot): A free daily contemplation card: draw one original Vedic-flavoured card each day, reflect on the prompt it offers, and keep a private journal of your insights over time.
- [Sacred Geometry Lab](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/yantra): Free sacred geometry lab: watch fourteen classical yantras (including the Sri Yantra) draw themselves stroke by stroke, and learn the precise mathematics — ratios, angles, the golden ratio — encoded in each.
- [Biorhythm Cycles](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/biorhythm): Free biorhythm calculator: plot your physical (23-day), emotional (28-day) and intellectual (33-day) cycles around today and see exactly where each wave sits right now.
- [Vastu Home Guide](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/vastu): Free Vastu Shastra compass: see which of the eight directions suits every room of your home — kitchen, bedroom, pooja room, entrance and more — with the element and classical reasoning behind each placement.
- [Kundalini Awakening](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/kundalini): A free, safety-first guided Kundalini meditation, two ways: follow the full video breath guide, or take the immersive animated journey as the coiled serpent rises through all seven chakras with rising tones, spoken bija mantras (English or हिन्दी) and selectable music.
- [Pranayama Breath Coach](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/pranayama): Free pranayama breathing coach: a glowing orb paces your breath through five classical techniques — Box breathing, 4-7-8, Nadi Shodhana and more — with voice pacing in English or हिन्दी and a nostril guide for alternate-nostril breathing.
- [Cosmic Sound Bath](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/soundbath): Free online sound bath: mix six sacred, generatively synthesised layers — tanpura, singing bowls, Om, rain, chimes and earth hum — live on your own sliders, with presets like Temple Rain and Deep Space. Nothing here is a recording.
- [Chakra Frequency Player](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/chakra-frequency-player): Free chakra frequency and sleep meditation player: choose from seven chakra tones and classic Solfeggio frequencies, layer in binaural or isochronic beats, and drift off with a crossfading sleep timer — every tone is synthesised live in your browser with the Web Audio API, not a recording.
- [Muhurta Finder](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/muhurta): Free Muhurta finder: a live 24-hour day-wheel computed from real sunrise and sunset for your location, showing the golden Abhijit and Brahma Muhurta windows to use, and Rahu Kaal, Yamaganda and Gulika Kaal periods to avoid.
- [Nakshatra Explorer](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/nakshatra): Free Nakshatra calculator: explore an interactive sky-wheel of all 27 lunar mansions, or enter your birth date and time to instantly find your janma nakshatra (birth star) and pada, with its ruling deity, symbol and nature.
- [Urdhva Shakti](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/urdhva): A free, compassionate companion for breaking free from porn: a one-tap Urge SOS with guided breath and upward-energy visualisation, a growing streak, the honest science of the dopamine loop, and a 90-day path toward ūrdhvaretas.
- [Daily Sādhana](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/sadhana): Free daily sadhana home base: see today’s tithi, nakshatra and a living moon phase at a glance, follow a three-step guided practice flow, and track your streak, the next sacred day, and today’s auspicious timing.
- [Ekadashi & Vrat Calendar](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/vrat-calendar): Free Ekadashi and vrat calendar: a living Hindu lunar calendar with an animated moon phase, computing today’s tithi and the upcoming Ekadashi, Purnima, Amavasya, Pradosh and more from the real positions of the Sun and Moon.
- [Puja & Aarti](https://vedicosmic.com/tools/puja-aarti): Free virtual puja and aarti: step into an online shrine for seven deities, ring the temple bell, offer flowers, blow the conch, or perform a full Aarti with a circling flame and each deity’s traditional invocation — all generated live, no audio files needed.

## Blog

- [Life Path Number Calculator: Full 2026 Guide to Meaning & Master Numbers](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/life-path-number-guide-2026): Learn to calculate your Life Path number by hand from your birth date, what numbers 1-9 mean, and why Master Numbers 11, 22 and 33 stay whole.
- [Lo Shu Grid Explained: Reading Your Birth-Date Magic Square](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/loshu-grid-explained): Learn to plot your birth date into the ancient Lo Shu Grid, decode its nine planetary numbers, and read the classic arrows of strength and weakness.
- [Numerology Compatibility: How Life Path Numbers Affect Relationships](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/numerology-compatibility-life-path): How numerologists compare two Life Path numbers to describe relationship dynamics — and why the reading stays one reflective lens, never a verdict.
- [Vedic vs Western Astrology: Why Your Moon Sign Might Be Different](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/vedic-vs-western-astrology): Why your Vedic Moon sign differs from your Western Sun sign — the real astronomical difference between the tropical and sidereal zodiacs, explained.
- [Nakshatras Explained: The 27 Lunar Mansions of Vedic Astrology](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/nakshatras-explained-27-lunar-mansions): What is your Nakshatra, or birth star? A clear guide to the 27 lunar mansions of Vedic astrology, their ruling deities, and what a Pada quarter is.
- [The 7 Chakras: A Beginner's Guide to Your Body's Energy Centers](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/seven-chakras-beginners-guide): A calm, practical guide to the 7 chakras — their traditional location, element and core meaning, from the grounding Root to the expansive Crown.
- [Panchang 101: Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga & Karana Explained](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/panchang-101-tithi-nakshatra): A clear guide to the Hindu Panchang and its five limbs — Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra, Yoga, and Karana — and why they still guide Muhurta and Vrat dates.
- [How to Start a Daily Spiritual Practice (Sadhana) That Actually Sticks](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/start-daily-spiritual-practice-sadhana): Sadhana means a disciplined daily spiritual practice. Learn why consistency beats intensity, and five realistic ways to make yours actually stick.
- [Ekadashi Fasting Guide: Dates, Rules & the Spiritual Meaning of Vrat](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/ekadashi-fasting-guide): What Ekadashi is, why it falls twice a month, and how the traditional fasting vrat works — including who should check with a doctor first.
- [Pranayama for Beginners: 5 Breathing Techniques to Calm Your Mind](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/pranayama-for-beginners): A practical beginner's guide to pranayama, the yogic art of breath control: five techniques, from calming Bhramari to energizing Kapalabhati, with safe steps.
- [Mobile Number Numerology: Does Your Phone Number's Vibration Matter?](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/mobile-number-numerology): Learn how mobile number numerology reduces your phone number to a root number, what repeating digits mean, and how to read it against your Life Path.
- [Chaldean Numerology Explained: The Ancient System Before Pythagoras](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chaldean-numerology-explained): Discover Chaldean numerology's ancient roots, its sound-based letter chart with no 9, and how to calculate a compound number from any name.
- [The Navagraha: Meet the Nine Planets of Vedic Astrology](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/navagraha-nine-planets-guide): Meet the Navagraha — the nine grahas of Vedic astrology, including shadow planets Rahu and Ketu — and how they shape Dashas and planetary hours.
- [Daily Card Contemplation: A Simple Reflection Ritual for Beginners](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/daily-card-contemplation-ritual): A daily contemplation card isn’t fortune-telling — it’s a simple reflective mirror. Learn a five-minute ritual for noticing what’s really on your mind.
- [What Is a Yantra? Sacred Geometry and the Math Behind the Sri Yantra](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/what-is-a-yantra-sacred-geometry): What a yantra actually is, how the Sri Yantra's nine triangles are built, and the geometry — and golden ratio claims — behind sacred diagrams.
- [What Are Biorhythms? Your Physical, Emotional & Intellectual Cycles](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/what-are-biorhythms-explained): A clear, honest look at biorhythm theory's physical, emotional and intellectual cycles — its origins, its appeal, and why science has not confirmed it works.
- [Vastu Shastra Basics: The Best Direction for Every Room in Your Home](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/vastu-shastra-basics): A practical introduction to Vastu Shastra — the eight-direction framework, the five elements, and which direction traditionally suits every room in your home.
- [Ūrdhvaretas & Brahmacharya: The Yogic View of Sexual Energy and Willpower](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/urdhvaretas-brahmacharya-yogic-view): A compassionate look at Brahmacharya and ūrdhvaretas — the yogic view of sexual energy — and how these ideas can gently support urge control.
- [Chakras 101: The Complete Guide to Your Body's Energy Centers](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chakras-101-complete-guide): What are chakras, how many are there, and how do you actually work with them? A complete, no-hype overview of the chakra system in one place.
- [The 7 Chakras Chart: Colors, Symbols, Mantras & Meanings](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/seven-chakras-chart-colors-symbols-mantras): A quick-reference chart for the 7 chakras — colors, seed mantras, symbols and meanings for Root through Crown, side by side.

- [All 7 Chakras Explained: Functions, Blockages & Healing Practices](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/all-7-chakras-functions-blockages-healing): Walk through all 7 chakras with their function, common signs of blockage, and a traditional healing practice for each — Root through Crown.

- [Vedic Chakras: How the Chakra System Connects to Jyotish and the Navagraha](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/vedic-chakras-jyotish-navagraha-connection): How does the chakra system show up in Vedic astrology? A look at how Jyotish practitioners connect the 7 chakras to the Navagraha, the nine planets.
- [Navagraha Remedies: Mantras, Gemstones & Rituals for the 9 Planets](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/navagraha-remedies-mantras-gemstones-rituals): Traditional Navagraha remedies for each of the 9 planets — mantras, gemstones, colors and simple rituals used to pacify a difficult graha.

- [Best Time to Meditate: Morning vs Evening Practice](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/best-time-to-meditate-morning-vs-evening): Is there really a best time to meditate? A clear, honest comparison of morning vs evening practice, plus what Vedic tradition adds to the question.
- [Chakra Sound Healing: Do Solfeggio Frequencies Really Work?](https://vedicosmic.com/blog/chakra-sound-healing-solfeggio-frequencies): Solfeggio frequencies are marketed as chakra-tuning sound healing tools. Here is what they actually are, their real history, and what science says.
